kinematics.name: Uniform Linear Motion
kinematics.description: Object moves with a constant velocity.
kinematics.scipy_func_code: lambda t, v, x0: v * t + x0

kinematics.name: Uniform Acceleration
kinematics.scipy_func_code: lambda t, a, v0, x0: 0.5 * a * t**2 + v0 * t + x0

dynamics.name: Simple Harmonic Motion
dynamics.formula_str: x(t) = A * cos(omega * t + phi) + offset
dynamics.scipy_func_code: lambda t, A, omega, phi, offset: A * np.cos(omega * t + phi) + offset

dynamics.name: Damped Oscillation
dynamics.formula_str: x(t) = A * exp(-beta * t) * cos(omega * t + phi)
dynamics.scipy_func_code: lambda t, A, beta, omega, phi: A * np.exp(-beta * t) * np.cos(omega * t + phi)
